The first person pays £24 and the second pays £28.

The fee depends on the date the payment is received. From 1 July 2025, annual adult membership costs £28 instead of £24, and payments received before 1 July 2025 keep the old fee (film-changes.md, section 1, decision of 16 June 2025, replacing film-fees.md 1.1).

- **First person:** their payment was received on 30 June 2025, before the change, so the £24 fee applies.
- **Second person:** their payment was received on 2 July 2025, after the change, so the £28 fee applies.
